title: Forbes told how VENTS became a global leader in the climate solutions industry - Blauberg Group
content: Home ᐳ Forbes told how VENTS became a global leader in the climate solutions industry. # Forbes told how VENTS became a global leader in the climate solutions industry. **Each of the companies that are part of the Blauberg Group has a long story to tell, as each of them has its own path to global recognition and its own unique experience. The history of VENTS’ growth caught the attention of the business publication Forbes Ukraine, which dedicated a separate** **article** **to it, revealing the main secrets of the famous ventilation equipment manufacturer’s success. One of the key areas of development for VENTS is its focus on offering the widest possible range of ventilation products. The company’s ventilation solutions are used in residential, commercial, and industrial facilities around the world, from hospitals in the US and China to office centers in Europe and Australia. Thanks to the integration of innovations at all stages of production, the company is able to quickly adapt its products to changes in international market requirements in the shortest possible time.
